// why: Type-checking WITHOUT a build step: allowJs + checkJs + noEmit means tsc reads the shipped .js
directly and emits nothing, so index.html keeps loading the same plain <script src> files.
Run it with `npm run typecheck` from dev/.
Scope is the Vue-free domain modules -- the ones that already have node:test coverage. app-core.js
and the backend adapters come later; they need the contract typed first.
